messages.author: 3b469b246ecd3a5b
messages.subject: order of legend and stacked bars in ggplot 0.8.8
parts:
In June I successfully used the tip at learnr (described here:
http://learnr.wordpress.com/2010/03/23/ggplot2-changing-the-default-order-of-legend-labels-and-stacking-of-data/
) to have the order in the legend and the order in the stacked bar go
the same way.

It no longer works for me. It's possible the issue is ggplot 0.8.8.

Here are the commands from the tip at learnr and what I see in my
plot:


# "Fair" on top of legend, on bottom of stacked bar
diamonds$cut <- factor(diamonds$cut)
ggplot(diamonds, aes(clarity, fill = cut)) + geom_bar()

diamonds$cut <- factor(diamonds$cut, levels = rev(levels(diamonds
$cut)))
# after reversing levels, "Fair" is now on bottom of legend and at the
top of the bar
ggplot(diamonds, aes(clarity, fill = cut)) + geom_bar()

# the proposed solution:
ggplot(diamonds, aes(clarity, fill = cut, order = -as.numeric(cut))) +
geom_bar()
# except order doesn't seem to have an effect.
# "Fair" still is on bottom of legend and at the top of the stacked
bar

# next I'll try scale_colour_hue
diamonds$cut <- factor(diamonds$cut, levels = levels(diamonds$cut))
ggplot(diamonds, aes(clarity, fill = cut, order = -as.numeric(cut))) +
geom_bar() + scale_colour_hue(breaks = rev(levels(diamonds
$cut)))
# "Fair" still is on bottom of legend and at the top of the stacked
bar


The problem seems to be that order doesn't change the order of the
areas in the stacked bar. I am working on windows xp, but I just
installed a fresh copy of R and ggplot2 on a neighboring Mac and saw
the same thing.

--John

messages.author: a5be32bcb3d808db
messages.subject: Re: order of legend and stacked bars in ggplot 0.8.8
parts:
Hi John,
You were close to a solution (see below).

On Tue, Aug 17, 2010 at 8:03 PM, John <browns...@gmail.com> wrote:
> In June I successfully used the tip at learnr (described here:
> http://learnr.wordpress.com/2010/03/23/ggplot2-changing-the-default-order-of-legend-labels-and-stacking-of-data/
> ) to have the order in the legend and the order in the stacked bar go
> the same way.
>
> It no longer works for me.  It's possible the issue is ggplot 0.8.8.
>
> Here are the commands from the tip at learnr and what I see in my
> plot:
>
>
> # "Fair" on top of legend, on bottom of stacked bar
> diamonds$cut <- factor(diamonds$cut)
> ggplot(diamonds, aes(clarity, fill = cut)) + geom_bar()
>
> diamonds$cut <- factor(diamonds$cut, levels = rev(levels(diamonds
> $cut)))
> # after reversing levels, "Fair" is now on bottom of legend and at the
> top of the bar
> ggplot(diamonds, aes(clarity, fill = cut)) + geom_bar()
>
> # the proposed solution:
> ggplot(diamonds, aes(clarity, fill = cut, order = -as.numeric(cut))) +
> geom_bar()
> # except order doesn't seem to have an effect.
> # "Fair" still is on bottom of legend and at the top of the stacked
> bar
>
> # next I'll try scale_colour_hue
> diamonds$cut <- factor(diamonds$cut, levels = levels(diamonds$cut))
> ggplot(diamonds, aes(clarity, fill = cut, order = -as.numeric(cut))) +
>     geom_bar() + scale_colour_hue(breaks = rev(levels(diamonds
> $cut)))
> # "Fair" still is on bottom of legend and at the top of the stacked
> bar

The color of the bars is controlled by scale_fill_* not,
scale_colour*. So I tried

ggplot(diamonds, aes(clarity, fill = cut)) + geom_bar() +
scale_fill_hue(breaks = rev(levels(diamonds$cut)))

and that seems to produced the desired effect.

Hope it helps,
Ista

>
>
> The problem seems to be that order doesn't change the order of the
> areas in the stacked bar.  I am working on windows xp, but I just
> installed a fresh copy of R and ggplot2 on a neighboring Mac  and saw
> the same thing.
>
> --John
